_comment: Example of agent/plan.json (what the kickoff and /change write). Import with: python3 scripts/kit.py import. This example file itself is never imported.

requirements.text: Users can sign up and sign in with email

features.title: Walking skeleton: project builds, one health endpoint, CI green

acceptance.check: With the database unreachable, GET /health returns 503 within 3 s
A user requests a sign-in link and is signed in after opening it
A sign-in link expires after exactly 15 minutes and works only once
6 sign-in requests for one email within 1 minute: the 6th returns 429
Signed-out requests to any /api/* route except /api/auth/* return 401
